concept: An adventurous comet lookout shaped by direction, distance, and an optimistic horizon.
floor: One continuous smooth cobalt-blue sandstone floor across the full top face, with broad coral dusk shading and no maps, arrows, grass, tiles, symbols, rings, or repeated pattern.
main_structure: One broad bow-curve observatory arch at the rear with a single large upward comet-fin ornament and a clear indigo horizon opening, abstract rather than a weapon.
side_props: one broad indigo supply chest and large compass-like blank disc on the upper-left edge
three large cobalt trail-stone forms on the upper-right edge

perimeter.material: one continuous rounded cobalt wall with broad coral and cream cap blocks
perimeter.emblems: four oversized comet-fin insets without arrows

lighting: soft clear dusk light with one broad warm horizon glow
must_keep: exact canonical camera, canvas, footprint, stairs, tapered underside, and padding
entire bottom/front half as quiet open cobalt-sandstone floor
all additions inside the original silhouette
must_exclude: creature, centaur, horse, person, bow, arrow, weapon, egg, or familiar baked into the bitmap
zodiac glyph, constellation, readable map, text, center circle, platform, plaza, ring, rug, path, or indentation
bridges, clouds, watermark, external shadow, star specks, tiny gear, cracks, or dense clutter
